SELECT
    o.${s_topic_field} as uid,
    o.${s_mdl_dte_field} as sample_mdl_dte,
    o.uid,
    o.stg_pln_sum_prc_amt_adv_rct_all_rto,
    o.stg_pln_sum_prc_amt_adv_rct_36m_rto,
    o.stg_pln_sum_prc_amt_adv_rct_24m_rto,
    o.stg_pln_sum_prc_amt_12m_36m_rto,
    o.stg_pln_sum_prc_amt_12m_24m_rto,
    o.stg_pln_pay_off_sum_prc_amt_d0_rep_rto,
    o.stg_pln_pay_off_sum_prc_amt_d0_rep_36m_rto,
    o.stg_pln_pay_off_sum_prc_amt_d0_rep_24m_rto,
    o.stg_pln_pay_off_sum_prc_amt_12m_all_rto,
    o.stg_pln_pay_off_sum_prc_amt_12m_36m_rto,
    o.stg_pln_pay_off_sum_prc_amt_12m_24m_rto,
    o.stg_pln_pay_off_cnt_d0_rep_rto,
    o.stg_pln_pay_off_cnt_d0_rep_36m_rto,
    o.stg_pln_pay_off_cnt_d0_rep_24m_rto,
    o.stg_pln_pay_off_cnt_12m_all_rto,
    o.stg_pln_pay_off_cnt_12m_36m_rto,
    o.stg_pln_pay_off_cnt_12m_24m_rto,
    o.stg_pln_cnt_adv_rct_all_rto,
    o.stg_pln_cnt_adv_rct_36m_rto,
    o.stg_pln_cnt_adv_rct_24m_rto,
    o.stg_pln_avg_prc_amt_36m_his_per_mth,
    o.stg_pln_avg_prc_amt_36m_his,
    o.stg_pln_avg_prc_amt_24m_his_per_mth,
    o.stg_pln_avg_prc_amt_24m_his,
    o.mdl_dte,
    o.ds
FROM (
        SELECT
            s.${s_topic_field},
            s.${s_mdl_dte_field},
            f.uid,
            f.stg_pln_sum_prc_amt_adv_rct_all_rto,
            f.stg_pln_sum_prc_amt_adv_rct_36m_rto,
            f.stg_pln_sum_prc_amt_adv_rct_24m_rto,
            f.stg_pln_sum_prc_amt_12m_36m_rto,
            f.stg_pln_sum_prc_amt_12m_24m_rto,
            f.stg_pln_pay_off_sum_prc_amt_d0_rep_rto,
            f.stg_pln_pay_off_sum_prc_amt_d0_rep_36m_rto,
            f.stg_pln_pay_off_sum_prc_amt_d0_rep_24m_rto,
            f.stg_pln_pay_off_sum_prc_amt_12m_all_rto,
            f.stg_pln_pay_off_sum_prc_amt_12m_36m_rto,
            f.stg_pln_pay_off_sum_prc_amt_12m_24m_rto,
            f.stg_pln_pay_off_cnt_d0_rep_rto,
            f.stg_pln_pay_off_cnt_d0_rep_36m_rto,
            f.stg_pln_pay_off_cnt_d0_rep_24m_rto,
            f.stg_pln_pay_off_cnt_12m_all_rto,
            f.stg_pln_pay_off_cnt_12m_36m_rto,
            f.stg_pln_pay_off_cnt_12m_24m_rto,
            f.stg_pln_cnt_adv_rct_all_rto,
            f.stg_pln_cnt_adv_rct_36m_rto,
            f.stg_pln_cnt_adv_rct_24m_rto,
            f.stg_pln_avg_prc_amt_36m_his_per_mth,
            f.stg_pln_avg_prc_amt_36m_his,
            f.stg_pln_avg_prc_amt_24m_his_per_mth,
            f.stg_pln_avg_prc_amt_24m_his,
            f.mdl_dte,
            f.ds,
            row_number() over(partition by s.${s_topic_field} order by f.ds desc) as rn
        FROM ${sample_table} s
        LEFT JOIN (
                    SELECT
                        *
                    FROM
                        dwa_risk.dwa_risk_dz_model_final_12his_rep_will_pressure_derived_new_df
                    WHERE
                        to_date(to_date(ds,'yyyyMMdd')) >= ${min_ds}
                    AND
                        ds <= ${max_ds}
                    ) f
        ON
            s.${s_topic_field} = f.uid
        AND
            datediff(to_date(s.${s_mdl_dte_field}),to_date(f.ds ,'yyyyMMdd')) = 0
    ) o  WHERE rn=1;
